scenarios.name: Change ribbon command size modes while editing a sketch

scenario_steps.name: a part has an active editable sketch in the MCAD Software
Ribbon Appearance is set to Normal
the user selects Small from the Ribbon Appearance submenu
command icons become smaller and the command area becomes shorter
the sketch remains active and unchanged
the user selects Compact from the Ribbon Appearance submenu
command icons form a dense horizontal layout within the panel groups
the sketch remains active and unchanged
the user selects Large from the Ribbon Appearance submenu
command icons become larger and occupy multiple rows
the sketch remains active and unchanged
the user selects Normal from the Ribbon Appearance submenu
the normal mixed-size command layout is restored
the sketch remains active and unchanged
